methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College represents peer-to-peer capability building outside metro hubs, signaling potential for deep, distributed AI fluency if it spreads beyond institutional walls into regional networks.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads demonstrate grassroots skill-building reaching beyond traditional tech centers, testing whether distributed deep learning can emerge from local champions rather than platform deployment.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's institutional AI partnership concentrates expertise and resources in Richmond Metro, deepening capability in the capital region but raising questions about knowledge diffusion to surrounding counties and underserved areas.

signals.title: Virginia nears universal broadband access
signals.signal_reading: Universal broadband access creates infrastructure for distributed AI adoption, but without simultaneous deep capability building, risks enabling shallow platform-mediated AI use rather than genuine regional AI fluency.

signals.title: Appalachian Power sees ‘explosive’ growth from data centers, other big customers
signals.signal_reading: Appalachian Power's data center growth concentrates energy infrastructure for AI computation in Southwest Virginia while local communities lack corresponding AI workforce development, creating resource extraction without capability building.
